mapper.sql: id, provider_id, provider_stop_id, parent_station_id, public_name, latitude, longitude, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transit_stop ( id, provider_id, provider_stop_id, parent_station_id, public_name, latitude, longitude, source_updated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{providerId}, #{providerStopId}, #{parentStationId}, #{publicName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (provider_id, provider_stop_id) DO UPDATE SET parent_station_id = EXCLUDED.parent_station_id, public_name = EXCLUDED.public_name, latitude = EXCLUDED.latitude, longitude = EXCLUDED.longitude, source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT rd.id AS "directionId", rd.display_name AS "directionName", ds.stop_id AS "stopId", ts.public_name AS "stopName", ds.stop_sequence AS "stopSequence", ts.latitude, ts.longitude, ds.next_stop_id AS "nextStopId", ds.display_direction AS "displayDirection" FROM route_direction rd INNER JOIN directed_stop ds ON ds.direction_id = rd.id INNER JOIN transit_stop ts ON ts.id = ds.stop_id WHERE rd.line_id = #{lineId} AND rd.active = TRUE ORDER BY rd.display_name, ds.stop_sequence ASC

SELECT rd.id AS "directionId", rd.display_name AS "directionName", destination.stop_id AS "stopId", destination_stop.public_name AS "stopName", destination.stop_sequence AS "stopSequence" FROM route_direction rd INNER JOIN directed_stop boarding ON boarding.direction_id = rd.id INNER JOIN directed_stop destination ON destination.direction_id = boarding.direction_id INNER JOIN transit_stop destination_stop ON destination_stop.id = destination.stop_id WHERE rd.line_id = #{lineId} AND boarding.stop_id = #{boardingStopId} AND rd.active = TRUE AND destination.stop_sequence > boarding.stop_sequence ORDER BY rd.display_name, destination.stop_sequence ASC
